notes.source: torch.profiler Chrome-trace JSON, iteration_20, ranks 0-3, under results/raw/prof
notes.step_window: host-side ProfilerStep#N user_annotation; device intervals clipped to it
notes.aggregation: per-rank median over the profiled steps, then median/min/max across ranks
notes.device_busy_programs: union of 'XLA Modules' events (one per device program execution)
notes.in_program_no_sync_op: time inside a program with no synchronous op running (waiting on async copies/collectives/DMA)
notes.barrier_wait: 'barrier-cores' TraceMe on the device; cross-chip barrier, i.e. waiting for other ranks; it lies inside program time
notes.collective_sync: union of XLA Ops with hlo_category all-gather / reduce-scatter / all-reduce-scatter fusion / all-reduce; these run on the TensorCore lane and do not overlap other sync ops
notes.collective_permute_async: collective-permute start..done spans on 'Async XLA Ops'; they overlap sync ops (overlap reported separately)
notes.host_blocked_in_item: aten::_local_scalar_dense on the main thread (.item(), blocking device->host sync)
notes.host_dispatch_semaphore_wait: 'Acquire semaphore' inside PJRT execute: dispatch blocked because the in-flight program queue is full (host ahead of device)
notes.idle_by_next_program_kind: device idle gap attributed to the kind of program that ends it; 'window_end' = tail of the step window
notes.idle_with_no_host_main_cpu_op: device idle time during which the host main thread has no recorded cpu_op (Python-level work is not traced: with_stack/python tracing off)
notes.unprofiled_step_ms_from_tps: 2048 tokens/step/chip / tps_per_chip from results/summary.json; results/summary.json step_ms is rounded to 10 ms because time_end_to_end is logged with 0.01 s resolution

notes.scope: whole profiled window (all ~5 steps plus window edges), not per step
notes.mxu_utilization_pct_reported: reported as 0.0 for every file; hardware perf counters were evidently not captured, so treat as not obtainable
notes.hbm_peak_in_use: heap allocated + stack reserved (program scratch) at the peak, per XProf memory_profile
